summary: FS page live ('Site Open', updated April 2026). Confirmed free, no potable water, open year-round, FCFS with no reservations; max rig 24 -> 23 ft ('less than 24 feet'). Sites count 5 and vault toilets left as stored (page silent). Note cleaned of field facts and the RV Life line.
flags: Rig limit: 'Road and campground access limited to recreational vehicles less than 24 feet.' EKKO at 23 ft is just under it - passes, but with no margin. No 4WD or high-clearance wording anywhere on the page.
Tents: 'Tents must be placed on tent pads' - a placement rule, not tent-only; the same sentence block admits RVs under 24 ft.
Road: FS alert 'Road Maintenance: West Cowpen Road (FSR 17)' - temporary delays 10/17-11/13/2026 up to its intersection with Mill Creek Road (FSR 630), the access road. Not a closure.
Phone missing: neither the campground page nor the Conasauga Ranger District page posts a district number (only the Supervisor's Office 770-297-3000). Not filled.
Pin 34.89411,-84.67213 is under full canopy on imagery - the sites can't be seen; unverified. Site count 5 and vault toilet rest on note prose (FS page: 'Restroom information is not available').
